# SQLite

SQLite amalgamation 3.54.1, downloaded from the official SQLite download page:
https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip

`sqlite/sqlite3.c` and `sqlite/sqlite3.h` are upstream source files, compiled directly into VoidSentinel.
The SQLite core is public domain: https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html

VoidSentinel does not use an external SQLite installation or load database extensions.
